telos: Produce a rigorous end-to-end proof of unrestricted Erdos 1041 and promote the parent claim only after fail-closed verification.
completion_condition: A checked full parent proof is landed in the source-current corpus, all used bridges are proved under matching hypotheses, the exact theorem statement is recovered, and consequence propagation is complete.
non_completion_states: a new sufficient condition without its universal premise
a packet batch that has not returned
a claimed full proof whose source implications fail audit

durability.compaction_rule: Resume from these disk artifacts and receipts; never reconstruct the frontier from chat memory.

active_cycle.current_operation: assimilate seven returned proof attempts and refine the unsent eight-packet scaffold in place to ten packets
active_cycle.productive_wait_invariant: Never poll or wait idly during packet compilation, validation, or any long command; use that wall time for disjoint proof search, claim comparison, counterexample analysis, or corpus refinement.
loop: extract and terminally adjudicate every mathematical claim
land verified lemmas, no-gos, and sharpened residuals in the corpus
propagate the updated frontier into every packet
compile and validate ten self-contained full-parent-proof packets
assimilate all returned responses as one batch
re-rank the proof frontier and refine the same packets again

proof_integrity.dominance_firewall: Rediscovering a lemma for which the corpus contains a stronger theorem is a failure mode, not progress. Activate the stronger theorem immediately, spend it as a premise, and attack the first unsupported downstream implication.
